sharing.title: Session sharing
sharing.noPermission: You don't have permission to manage session sharing.
sharing.description: Control whether users on this server can share sessions with others. Applies server-wide and takes effect immediately. Changes affect only new shares — existing grants (including already-public sessions) keep working until revoked.
sharing.managedMode: The sharing mode is managed by this deployment and can't be changed here.
sharing.publicDescription: Allow sharing a session with anyone who has the link (public read access). When off, the Share dialog's "Public access" toggle is hidden and new public grants are rejected; sessions already shared publicly stay public until revoked.
sharing.managedPublic: Managed by this deployment and can't be changed here.

on.label: On
on.description: Anyone with manage access can share a session at any level (read, edit, or manage) and toggle public / workspace read.

read_only.label: Read only
read_only.description: New shares are capped at read (view) access. Edit and manage grants are rejected.

restricted_read_only.label: Read only (restricted)
restricted_read_only.description: Read-only, and sessions whose working directory is a home directory or the filesystem root cannot be shared at all — not even read.

off.label: Off
off.description: Sharing is disabled. No new grants can be created and the Share control is hidden.
